Beat 'clocks': 'the sun rises over Tokyo while London is fast asleep' is wrong. Tokyo sunrise (about 04:25-06:50 JST across the year) is about 19:25-21:50 the evening before in London (JST is 8-9 h ahead), so London is still awake at dinner, not asleep. A true version: 'the sun rises over Tokyo while London is still eating dinner' or 'the sun sets over Tokyo just as London wakes up' (Tokyo sunset about 16:30-19:00 JST = about 07:30-10:00 London).
